summary: Fresh-session frontend verification of Cris d'un Cœur. All 10 routes load without webpack overlay or console errors. /connexion desktop shows the intended split layout: dark image branding panel on the LEFT with 'Rejoignez la communauté...' text; PLAIN WHITE (bg-[#FDFDFD]) form panel on the RIGHT with Connexion/Inscription tabs, Google button and email/password inputs — no background image, no blur, no floating card behind form on right. Cart add-to-cart works from /boutique and /panier renders.
action_items: User's 'Je vois pas la mise à jour' is a client-side browser cache issue. The live preview URL serves the updated login layout (image left / white form right) as expected. Advise user to hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) or open in incognito.
critical_code_review_comments: Connexion.jsx right panel is correctly plain 'bg-[#FDFDFD]' with 'w-full max-w-md' and no image/blur/card overlay — matches spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site, no backend. Live preview confirmed up-to-date on fresh browser context. All routes: /, /causes, /evenements, /blog, /boutique, /panier, /a-propos, /contact, /connexion, /espace-membre load cleanly.
rca of the issue: User's browser was serving a stale cached bundle of /connexion. The deployed preview build already reflects the image-left/white-form layout; verified via a fresh Playwright context (cleared cookies). Mitigation: user should hard-reload or use incognito.
